description: In every PA-model, each nonempty set defined by a fixed arithmetic formula with finitely many parameters has a least element in the arithmetic order.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PAComputations.least_witness_model.{u} {k : ℕ} {M : Type u}
  [Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Structure M]
  [M ⊨ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.PA]
  (φ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.language.Formula (Fin k ⊕ Unit)) (x : Fin k → M)
  (h : ∃ y, φ.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x y)) :
  ∃ y,
    φ.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x y) ∧
      ∀ (z : M),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.leValue M
            (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticTheories.succValue M z) y →
          ¬φ.Realize (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ArithmeticRepresentability.extend x z)
